# Capital.com — How to import trades from Capital.com into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/12639717-capital-com-how-to-import-trades-from-capital-com-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

To seamlessly import your trades from Capital.com into TradeZella, follow the steps below.



- Log in to your Capital.com account.

Log in to your Capital.com account.

- Click on the “Reports” tab from the left sidebar.

Click on the “Reports” tab from the left sidebar.

- Go to the “Trades” tab.

Go to the “Trades” tab.

- Ensure all statuses are selected in the dropdown at the top.

Ensure all statuses are selected in the dropdown at the top.

- Choose your desired date range (we recommend selecting the full range to include all trades).

Choose your desired date range (we recommend selecting the full range to include all trades).

- Click the “Send report” button.

Click the “Send report” button.

- A CSV report will be sent to your email inbox — download this file.

A CSV report will be sent to your email inbox — download this file.



Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page or click the “Add Trade” button from the sidebar.

- If you’re importing into a new account, click “Add New Account”.

If you’re importing into a new account, click “Add New Account”.

- Choose  Capital.com as your broker.

Choose  Capital.com as your broker.

- Click Continue.

Click Continue.

- Select File Upload and click Continue

Select File Upload and click Continue

- Upload your CSV file

Upload your CSV file

- If you’re uploading to an existing account, click the “+ Add Trades” button on the account → Select File Upload → Proceed as above.

If you’re uploading to an existing account, click the “+ Add Trades” button on the account → Select File Upload → Proceed as above.

## 

- Make sure you export the file from the Trades tab in the Reports section.

Make sure you export the file from the Trades tab in the Reports section.

- Sample File: If your file still fails to upload, please ensure it matches the sample Captial.com export shown below. If it doesn’t, you may have missed an export step or selected the wrong file format.

Sample File: If your file still fails to upload, please ensure it matches the sample Captial.com export shown below. If it doesn’t, you may have missed an export step or selected the wrong file format.



Importing your trades from Capital.com into TradeZella is designed to be user-friendly and efficient. By following these steps, you'll maintain accurate trading records and gain insights to optimize your trading strategies. Happy trading! 🚀
